app.name: VisualMetrics
app.tagline: See the theory. Change the assumptions. Understand the model.
app.subtitle: Interactive visual laboratory for statistics, econometrics and AI

nav.search_placeholder: Search a concept in English, Arabic or French…

formal_proof.label: Formal proof
formal_proof.caveat: A complete mathematical argument, not a picture of one.

symbolic_derivation.label: Symbolic derivation
symbolic_derivation.caveat: Each algebraic step is shown and can be checked.

geometric_proof.label: Geometric proof
geometric_proof.caveat: The geometry is exact: the drawn relation is the theorem.

visual_derivation.label: Visual derivation
visual_derivation.caveat: A faithful visual account of a valid derivation, not a substitute for it.

visual_intuition.label: Visual intuition
visual_intuition.caveat: Intuition only. It suggests why a result is plausible; it proves nothing.

simulation.label: Simulation
simulation.caveat: Finite Monte Carlo evidence. A simulation is never a proof of a theorem.

numerical_demonstration.label: Numerical demonstration
numerical_demonstration.caveat: Exact computation for the displayed parameter values only.

counterexample.label: Counterexample
counterexample.caveat: One valid counterexample is enough to refute a universal claim.

empirical_example.label: Empirical example
empirical_example.caveat: Real data illustrate; they do not verify a theorem.

ui.planned_notice: This concept is catalogued for transparency but is not implemented yet.
ui.simulation_note: Monte Carlo evidence with {reps} repetitions (simulation standard error shown).
ui.catalogue_size: {implemented} implemented labs out of {total} catalogued concepts

assumptions.exogeneity: Zero conditional mean of the error (exogeneity)
assumptions.sutva: SUTVA (no interference, one version of treatment)
assumptions.no_manipulation: No manipulation of the running variable
assumptions.regularity: Regularity conditions for the asymptotic result

seed.label: Seed
seed.help: Fixes the random draws so the picture is reproducible.

n.label: Sample size (n)
n.help: Number of observations in each sample.

alpha.label: Significance level (alpha)
alpha.help: Probability of rejecting a true null hypothesis.

effect_size.label: Effect size
effect_size.help: Standardized distance between the null and the alternative.

noise.label: Noise (sd of the error)
noise.help: Standard deviation of the unobserved error term.

beta0.label: Intercept (beta0)
beta0.help: Value of y when x equals zero.

beta1.label: Slope (beta1)
beta1.help: Change in y for a one-unit change in x.

functional_form.label: Functional form
functional_form.help: Shape of the true relationship between x and y.

correlation.label: Correlation
correlation.help: Linear dependence between the two variables.

foundations_of_inference.title: Foundations of statistical inference
foundations_of_inference.summary: From a probability distribution to sampling variability, intervals, tests and power.

estimation_theory.title: Estimation theory
estimation_theory.summary: Method of moments, maximum likelihood, information, efficiency bounds and resampling.

regression_from_scratch.title: Regression from scratch
regression_from_scratch.summary: Projection geometry, least squares, partialling out and coefficient stability.

diagnostics_and_remedies.title: Diagnostics and remedies
diagnostics_and_remedies.summary: Detect a violated assumption, measure the damage, apply the remedy, see what it does not fix.

identification_and_causality.title: Identification and causality
identification_and_causality.summary: From omitted-variable bias to graphs, instruments and quasi-experimental designs.

time_series_econometrics.title: Time-series econometrics
time_series_econometrics.summary: Stationarity, ARMA modelling, cointegration, VAR dynamics and volatility.

machine_learning_essentials.title: Machine-learning essentials
machine_learning_essentials.summary: Generalization, regularization, thresholds, optimization and dimension reduction.

from_gradients_to_transformers.title: From gradients to transformers
from_gradients_to_transformers.summary: Gradient descent, backpropagation, attention and post-hoc explanation.

quiz.title: Check your understanding
quiz.no_grading: This quiz is formative only. It is not a graded assessment.
